commands.summary: Article, listing API, detail API, two WebP assets, and 800px optimized thumbnail all returned expected 200 responses.
Exit 0; TypeScript, static generation, and OpenNext Worker bundle completed. Existing Sass/punycode warnings and a logged ENVIRONMENT_FALLBACK stack did not fail the build.
Predev regenerated the Pages/local content loader; fresh article GET returned HTTP 200, 130397 bytes.
After sourcing .env.local into the process, deployment variables passed validation; secret values were not recorded.

urls.verification: Fresh post-build render using standard pnpm dev predev.

orcaManual.notes: An initial tab attempt targeted the wrong worktree and returned browser_no_tab; retried by creating a tab with the explicit MEARROW worktree ID. Two full-page screenshot artifacts were malformed and removed; retained the clean detail viewport screenshot.

retries.error: Orca browser tab was created in the default unrelated worktree; snapshot returned browser_no_tab.
retries.resolution: Created the browser tab with the explicit MEARROW feature-worktree ID; route checks passed.

retries.error: Orca full-page screenshot output repeated viewport content and produced a blank body artifact.
retries.resolution: Deleted malformed screenshots and retained the clean detail viewport screenshot.

retries.error: After `pnpm workers:build`, direct Next dev returned 404 for existing and new article routes; the build had regenerated ignored `src/generated/news-runtime.ts` with the Workers-only Cloudflare ASSETS loader. Concurrent worker build also removed `.next` while the prior dev process was running, producing Turbopack missing-SST cache errors.
retries.resolution: Stopped only the local dev process and restarted with `pnpm dev`, which ran predev and restored the local generated-content loader; fresh request returned HTTP 200. Workers build itself exited 0. No product source file was changed for this recovery.

retries.error: Initial pnpm check:deploy-env did not inherit .env.local and reported three required public integration variables missing.
retries.resolution: Queried Vault issue 09-Issue/2026-09-12-mearrow-deploy-env-not-loaded.md and followed its verified fix: source .env.local into the current process without printing values, then rerun; check passed.

retries.error: git add emitted an ignored-path warning for tracked src/generated/news-meta.json and exited 1 after staging the requested set.
retries.resolution: Queried and read the matching verified Vault issue 09-Issue/2026-10-13-MEARROW-git-add-src-generated-ignore-warning.md; git status and cached-name listing confirmed news-meta.json and all intended files were staged.

retries.error: git diff --cached --check found trailing whitespace on two hard-break lines in the dedicated Playwright QA report.
retries.resolution: Removed trailing spaces, refreshed the staged report, and reran git diff --cached --check successfully.
